title: WF03 stage11 releasefix: ADP-07 TC-ADP-07-01 failed because AGENT_RUNNER seed role was missing after test DB cleanup
summary: Integration test TC-ADP-07-01 expected the AGENT_RUNNER role to exist in roles but queryRow returned null. Root cause was cleanup drift: schema_migrations stayed populated while roles seed data could be absent.

root_cause.details: tools/clean_test_db.py truncated transient tables but did not enforce mandatory role seeds. When roles seed data was missing, ADP-07 assertion failed even though migrations were already marked applied.

commands.command: python tools/clean_test_db.py; docker-compose exec -T db_test psql -U bpm -d bpm_test -c "SELECT name FROM roles ORDER BY name;"
commands.evidence: roles contains AGENT_RUNNER, PLATFORM_ADMIN, PROCESS_DESIGNER, PROCESS_OPERATOR, TASK_WORKER, VIEWER

commands.command: cmd /c "set BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test&& set BPM_TEST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080&& set BPM_IDP_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8081&& zig build test-integration && echo INTEGRATION_EXIT_CODE=%ERRORLEVEL%"

prevention: Integration DB cleanup must reseed mandatory identity roles on every run.
Deterministic integration evidence should verify baseline role seeds before running the suite.
